g.title: PackPlatformReadiness
g.text: Oxygen Time Lab — Cycle 175
Pack Platform and Cross-World Readiness
Shared behavior map • proposed for owner review • no implementation authorized

g.title: cluster_baselines
g.text: A. Repeatability, baseline, and local proof — independent exits

g.title: cluster_persistence
g.text: B. Catalog and launch restoration

g.title: cluster_settings
g.text: C. Settings catalog and selection

g.title: cluster_verification
g.text: D. Installed verification and measured switch cost

g.title: cluster_substitution
g.text: E. Definition-driven visual substitution and cross-pack truth

g.title: cluster_readiness
g.text: F. Readiness summary and separate switch-specific proofs

g.title: foundations
g.text: Resolved foundations (DONE)
OX-19 / OX-32: world choice preserves weather and timeline state
OX-31 / OX-41: app-owned catalog and bundled-free role
OX-55 / OX-57 / OX-56: renderer, local install, resolution recovery
OX-24 / OX-36 / OX-38 / OX-92: scene substitution and typed weather inputs
OX-12: exact selected-time reading and evidence

g.title: invariants
g.text: Across every switch and substitution
Keep the same place, catalog revision, exact selected instant, forecast facts, and timeline state.
No switch-triggered forecast fetch or Activity/process restart.
Activate a complete candidate atomically; preserve supported, carried, and unavailable weather truth.
No new plausibility rules, paid channel, Park polish, or executable pack content.

g.title: ox09
g.text: OX-09 • repeat selection
Sample the same world and selected time again.
Record repeatability; add stable seeds only if re-randomization is observed.
Preserve the meaning of selection and motion.

g.title: ox96
g.text: OX-96 • first-pack baseline
Measure selected-time evaluation, package/scene resolution, first frame, and one in-session switch separately.
Record the reference device and workload.
Measurement only; no cache or global refactor.

g.title: ox29
g.text: OX-29 • TEST: local build/import proof
Cover bundled free access, reproducible local artifact, valid and invalid imports, alternate rendering, and first weather-safe switch.
Report pass / fail / not run; no commerce provider.

g.title: ox73
g.text: OX-73 • switch/restore cost
Measure repeated valid switches and cold restore after OX-96.
Report memory and latency, then record retain/follow-up.
Any optimization needs a separate slice.

g.title: ox78
g.text: OX-78 • TEST: switching and recovery
Exercise repeat switches, cold restoration, unavailable selection, and recovery.
Record continuity, no restart, and fallback with explicit outcomes.

g.title: ox93
g.text: OX-93 • TEST: local platform readiness
Reconcile OX-29, OX-78, OX-79, OX-98, and OX-73.
Separate proven, failed, not-run, and blocked capabilities.
Record an owner milestone decision; no release approval.

g.title: ox58
g.text: OX-58 • restore catalog
After cold relaunch, rediscover the same app-owned pack ID/version.
Keep the bundled free entry present.
Do not rely on process memory or scan shared storage.

g.title: ox61
g.text: OX-61 • restore chosen theme
Persist a stable pack/variant choice separately from place and forecast state.
Restore it when still available and compatible.
Settings UI is outside this slice.

g.title: ox33
g.text: OX-33 • list themes
Settings lists the bundled free world and installed catalog entries.
Show compatible, incompatible, and active status as text.
No selection, download, or checkout behavior.

g.title: ox62
g.text: OX-62 • unavailable choice
If the saved theme is unavailable at launch, restore the OX-41 bundled free default: Living Urban Park.
Show truthful catalog status; preserve forecast access.
OX-56's First City fallback remains limited to its resolution-failure path.

g.title: ox69
g.text: OX-69 • select from Settings
Route a valid choice through the existing OX-32 hot-swap path and OX-61 persistence.
Keep invalid entries disabled and status clear.
Do not duplicate scene loading.

g.title: ox98
g.text: OX-98 • TEST: core choice accessibility
Check Settings announcements, focus, disabled/unavailable status, selection, and exact weather access.
Use the bundled and one installed world.
Keep broad system acceptance out of this slice.

g.title: ox79
g.text: OX-79 • TEST: truth across packs
For supported, carried, and unavailable cases, compare exact instant, source validity, units, and interpretation across bundled/installed worlds.
Record pass / fail / not run per case.

g.title: ox39
g.text: OX-39 • one visual treatment
Declare an alternate treatment for one existing rendering capability.
Keep the same weather input, element identity, and depth.
No arbitrary plug-in renderer.

g.title: ox40
g.text: OX-40 • two-world parity
Compare the First City CANOPY and the adapted left Open Landscape tree group.
Record shared weather meaning, forecast access, unknown handling, and unsupported gaps.
Do not add Park art.

g.title: ox59
g.text: OX-59 • scrub/switch overlap
Overlap one timeline scrub with one theme switch.
End with one coherent selected instant and active scene, without stale selection or gesture theft.
Distinct from ordinary OX-32 switching.

g.title: ox60
g.text: OX-60 • theme resource lifecycle
After repeated free ↔ alternate swaps, remove old visual layers, transformed hit regions, and animation state.
Keep only the current theme's resources and targets.
No unrelated cache framework.
